name: gchat-preview-html
description: Chrome extension that previews HTML attachments inline in Google Chat.

scripts.build:all: vite build --mode background && vite build --mode content && vite build --mode sandbox && vite build --mode options && vite build --mode mermaid
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run clean && npm run build:all
scripts.dev: vite build --mode background --watch & vite build --mode content --watch & vite build --mode sandbox --watch & vite build --mode options --watch & vite build --mode mermaid --watch & wait
scripts.icons: rsvg-convert -w 16 -h 16 assets/icon-small.svg -o public/icons/icon16.png && rsvg-convert -w 32 -h 32 assets/icon-small.svg -o public/icons/icon32.png && rsvg-convert -w 48 -h 48 assets/icon.svg -o public/icons/icon48.png && rsvg-convert -w 128 -h 128 assets/icon.svg -o public/icons/icon128.png
